goal: Close two confirmed dApp-facing gaps: postProviderEvent (defined in apps/extension/entrypoints/content/index.ts, never called) never actually notifies a connected page of connect/disconnect/active-wallet-change events, and switchWallet(walletId) is only callable from trusted extension UI with no provider method or event exposing an active-account change to a connected dApp.
outcome: postProviderEvent is called on connect, disconnect, and active-wallet change, reaching the page-side handleEvent() listener in apps/extension/entrypoints/provider/index.ts that already exists idle. Connected dApps receive a walletSwitch-equivalent event when the active account changes underneath them, matching the arweaveWalletLoaded/walletSwitch convention Wander's docs establish. No new password-based or trust-bypassing surface is added -- this only wires already-defined plumbing (postProviderEvent, handleEvent) and adds the missing event-emission call sites.

requirements.statement: postProviderEvent is called from the existing connect, disconnect, and switchWallet code paths in wallet-lifecycle.ts / background dispatch -- it is not reimplemented, only invoked at the correct call sites.

Only a connected dApp (one holding an active Grant for the current origin) receives these events -- an origin with no connection approval never receives account or connection state changes, preserving the existing connection-approval boundary.
A connected page's handleEvent() listener receives a connect event on approval, a disconnect event on disconnection, and a walletSwitch-equivalent event when switchWallet changes the active wallet.

pnpm vitest run provider bridge approval connected-apps content/index background/index passes; pnpm tsc -p packages/messaging --noEmit and pnpm tsc -p packages/core --noEmit pass; pnpm wxt build succeeds.
